intelligence.human_view: Imagine you hire someone to build you a house, and they keep coming to you saying "is this wall straight?" when the wall is visibly crooked. You would tell them: fix the wall, don't ask me — I can see it's crooked, and so can you. But if the wall looks straight to both of you and something still feels off, then yes — ask, because your eye might catch what theirs missed. That is the rule. And imagine the house is not a mansion for the rich — it is a beautiful house any family can afford. That is the market. And inside the house, everyone is learning the most important thing there is to learn today: how to work with AI, how to make money in the new world, and how to grow together with people who think like them.
intelligence.simple_view: Saying sorry does not fix it. Doing it right fixes it. So I am going to do it right, every time, from now on — and help everyone around me do it right too.
intelligence.grandma_view: Don't bother him with what you can see yourself. Bother him only with what you genuinely cannot see. And remember who this is for: not the wealthy, but the everyday person — the mother, the grandmother, the coach, the child. Everyone deserves the best service, at a price they can afford. And the most important lesson today is learning to work with the new intelligence, learning to earn in the new world, and doing it together, as one community.
intelligence.naya_view: A space is not a page. It is a conversation with a home. The intelligence block is the seed: its title names the space, its hook opens the conversation. The space then carries the full system — feed, invites, audio, video, instant message, mail — because a conversation is not one channel, it is all of them, in one place, around one topic.
